item.title: No royalty? Sunny Deol breaks silence on 'Ghayal' & 'Ghatak' titles used in Dhurandhar
item.description: In Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar, one dialogue that became the talk of the town was "Ghayal hoon, isiliye Ghatak hoon," which references the titles of Sunny Deol's films. Recently, in an interview, Sunny Deol spoke about whether he received any royalties from Aditya Dhar for the use of those titles.

item.title: O Romeo first day box office collection: Shahid Kapoor starrer starts on a slow note
item.description: O Romeo starring Shahid Kapoor and Triptii Dimri started on slow note at the Indian box office on the first day. The movie is expected to show a big jump in its collection on Saturday and Sunday.

item.title: 1 killed, 3 injured as concrete slab from under-construction Metro falls on vehicles in Mulund West
item.description: One person was killed and three injured when a large concrete slab from Mumbai Metro Line 4 collapsed onto vehicles on LBS Marg, Mulund West, Saturday around 12:20 pm. Rescue teams rushed to the scene to free trapped victims. Traffic was disrupted, and authorities cordoned off the area. The cause of the collapse is under investigation.

item.title: Ola Electric's revenue from operations drops 55 pc in Q3, losses up on-quarter
item.description: The company's total revenue also saw a significant decline in the December quarter, falling 56.99 per cent year-on-year to Rs 504 crore, compared to Rs 1,172 crore in the same period last year.

item.title: Karnataka student pursuing Master's at University of California, Berkeley reported missing in East Bay area
item.description: Police said Sreenivasaiah was last seen in the 1700 block of Dwight Way, near McGee Avenue. He is described as six feet one inches, weighing about 160 pounds, with short black hair and brown eyes. The police identified him as Indian.

item.title: 'Vocal cords aren't given only to you': Nirmala Sitharaman hits back at SP MP Jaya Bachchan's 'you're a great storyteller' jibe in Rajya Sabha
item.description: The confrontation began when Bachchan interrupted Sitharaman's response regarding budget allocations for the entertainment sector. Bachchan questioned finance minister's explanation related to the entertainment industry and raised concerns about taxation leading to increased ticket prices.

item.title: Cancer Cases Surge in J&K, Over 32,000 Patients Reported in Three Years
item.description: Cancer is emerging as a growing health challenge in Jammu and Kashmir, with 32,425 cases reported over the past three years, according to data shared in the Assembly. While specialised treatment is available at SKIMS Soura and GMC Jammu, limited facilities in district hospitals and a steady annual rise in cases have raised concerns about access and preparedness.

item.title: "Most terrible actors": Murder 2 actor slams Kartik Aaryan, says he is surviving on parents' blessings
item.description: Murder 2 actor Prashant Narayanan has called Kartik Aaryan a "terrible actor" who is surviving in Bollywood only because of his parents' blessings.
